contexts.text: Yesterday, in the supreme sense, = from eternity. AC 9939.
Not as yesterday and the day before () = the state quite changed.
Even from yesterday, even from the day before yesterday () = not from eternity. Explained.
As yesterday and the day before yesterday () = not as in the former state. AC 7139.
Both yesterday and today () = a derivative future state; for yesterday = a prior state; and today, what is perpetual.
From yesterday the day before () = a precedent state and time. AC 9095.
A thousand years in Thy sight are as yesterday ().
